blocks.text: Exercise mein das multiple choice, aath short (chhote) aur saat long (lambe) sawal hain. Sawal neeche kitab ki tarah English mein hain. Multiple choice ke jawab is lesson ke table mein hain; short aur long sawalon ke jawab un ke topics ke Roman Urdu lessons mein self-check ki shakal mein hain.
Multiple choice sawal
1. Which of the following steps is NOT part of the basic programming process?
2. What should you do when installing Python to run it from the command line more easily?
3. Which of the following is a valid variable name in Python?

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab options (a) aur (b) ko variablel (chhota L) aur Ivariable (bara i) chhapti hai; is tarah dono sahi naam ban jate hain. Asal mein variable1 aur 1variable likhna tha; phir sirf (a) sahi hai, kyunke naam digit se shuru nahi ho sakta.
4. What is the output of the below code?
age = 25; print (" Age : " , age)
5. Which of the following operators is used for exponentiation in Python?

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab option (c) ko "(O //" aur (d) ko "7." chhapti hai. (c) floor division // hai, aur (d) shayad modulus % (yahi ghalti Long Question 1 mein % ko 7 bana deti hai).
6. Which loop type in Python is used to iterate over a collection such as lists?
7. What does the range () function do in Python?
8. Which keyword is used to define a function in Python?
9. What is the output of the below code?

temperature, humidity, wind_speed =25, 60, 15
print("Hot and humid" if temperature > 30 and humidity > 50 else
"Warm and breezy" if temperature == 25 and wind_speed > 10 else
"Cool and dry" if temperature < 20 and humidity < 30 else
"Moderate ")
10. Which operation is used to combine two lists?

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab option (b) ko concatO chhapti hai; yeh concat() hai (brackets ( ) ki jagah O chhap gaya).

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir (PDF 226) ki answer key Unit 2 ke liye 1a 2b 3a 4b 5c 6a 7b 8a 9a 10a deti hai. Text ke mutabiq jawab 1d 2c 3a 4a 5b 6b 7b 8c 9b 10c hain; sirf 3 aur 7 milte hain, is liye lagta hai key ka column ghalat jagah chhapa hai. MCQ 9 ka asal output "Warm and breezy" hai (25 == 25 aur 15 > 10).

blocks.text: Kitab (a) aur (e) mein operator ki jagah "9 7, 4" aur "10 7. 3" chhapti hai; yeh Python nahi. Inhein modulus % maan kar oopar likha gaya hai.
2. In Mathematical (riyazi) expressions ko Python syntax mein likhein:
(b) kitab mein itna kharab chhapa hai ke parha nahi ja sakta ("7 + 2²   1   7").

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab (d) mein 1 ki jagah "l" (letter) chhapti hai, aur ek hi sawal ke liye number "2." aur "3." dono dete hai. (c) mein (3+7) ka square (²) door chhapa hai.

blocks.prompt: Long question 2: Python mein likhein: (a) 15 x (3 + 2 ka square) divided by (6 - 2 x 3); (d) 9 x (2 ka cube + 1) - 15 + 3 divided by (5 + 4) x (2 + 3); (c) (12 + 5 x 4 - (3 + 7) ka square) divided by 2 x (5 ka square - 24).
blocks.explanation: (a) 15 * (3 + 2 ** 2) / (6 - 2 * 3); dhyan rahe ke denominator (neeche wala hissa) 0 hai, to Python ZeroDivisionError degi. (c) (12 + 5 * 4 - (3 + 7) ** 2) / (2 * (5 ** 2 - 24)) = (32 - 100) / 2 = -34.0. (d) ghalat chhape 'l' ko 1 maan kar: (9 * (2 ** 3 + 1) - 15 + 3) / ((5 + 4) * (2 + 3)) = 69 / 45 = 1.53. Hissa (b) itna kharab chhapa hai ke parha aur likha nahi ja sakta.

7. temperature_converter.py module banayein jis mein do functions hon:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab fraction (kasar) ki jagah "|" chhapti hai (F=|xC + 32, C = | x (F — 32)). Sahi formulas F = 9/5 x C + 32 aur C = 5/9 x (F - 32) hain. Jawab 2.7.1 ke self-check mein hai: 25 °C = 77.0 °F aur 77 °F = 25.0 °C.
Phir main.py likhein jo module import kare aur: (a) 25 °C ko Fahrenheit mein badal kar print kare; (b) 77 °F ko Celsius mein badal kar print kare.
